label: Fair
corporate_parent: AHF Products (formerly Armstrong Flooring). Brands: Bruce, Armstrong, Hartco. Post-bankruptcy reorganization.
manufacturing_location: Beverly, WV and Somerset, KY (multiple US plants) — confirm specific plant for Dundee

species_grade.description: Standard #1 Common grade. Builder-grade floor — functional with moderate natural variation.

finish_system.description: Dura-Shield aluminum oxide finish — standard grade. Not premium density or coat count.

milling_precision.description: Installer consensus: Bruce milling has loosened in recent years. Tongue-and-groove fit is adequate but requires more filler and adjustment than premium brands. This is the primary complaint.

performance_evidence.refinishing_potential: Unlimited — 3/4" solid. The wood itself is fine. The product performs well once installed and finished properly.
performance_evidence.dimensional_stability: Good — standard kiln-dried solid. Narrow 2-1/4" strip is actually more dimensionally stable than wide plank.
performance_evidence.moisture_resistance: Standard solid — same limitations as all solid hardwood.

finish_warranty.description: 15-year residential finish warranty — below 25-35 year premium standard

durability_evidence.warranty_claim_process: Standard manufacturer — AHF Products post-bankruptcy status creates uncertainty
durability_evidence.corporate_stability: AHF Products went through bankruptcy reorganization (Armstrong Flooring bankruptcy 2022). Current financial stability uncertain. Warranty backing is a concern.

safety_evidence.formaldehyde: Solid hardwood — inherently very low emissions.

platform_disclosure.cross_brand: Bruce/Armstrong/Hartco brands share AHF Products manufacturing platform. Report must disclose.
